value.text: Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for residents, and the general public opens 7 days later. Max fits the published age band. Mia is just outside it, so please check she fits before you register. Once you pick a course, send me its page and the morning text will carry the link: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026. I'll text you a week ahead, three days ahead, the evening before, and 15 minutes before it opens. I never register for you; you do that yourself on the link.
